findings.text: During the degree steps (01_3, about 30.6-31.5 s), the 'terms up to degree' counter switches to the next value at the start of each curve morph. Mid-morph stills therefore show a counter one step ahead of the curve: 8 with the degree-6 shape at 30.8 s (f1848), and 10 with the degree-8 shape at 31.4 s (f1884, sheet 8 slot 6). Each step lasts under a second and settles. Whether it reads as wrong in motion needs a motion review; this is only what the stills show.
